It is pertinent to note that the Commission, vide Order dated 28.4.2026 in Petition No. 7/SM/2026, had initiated Suo-motu proceedings against the Applicant for willful default in depositing the annual licence fee for the preceding two financial years (2024-25 and 2025-26), as well as for failure to undertake any trading activity and submit requisite information. The instant Petition for surrender of Inter-State trading licence was filed subsequent to the issuance of the said _Suo-motu_ notice. By retaining the Category ‘V’ trading licence and failing to file the surrender Petition prior to the commencement of Financial Year 2026-27, the Applicant remained a licensee in the records of the Commission and was obligated to pay the annual licence fee for Financial Year 202627, which was required to be paid till 30.4.2026. The Applicant has deposited the fee for the said financial year, seemingly to rectify its defaults and comply with its statutory obligations in light of the Suo-motu proceedings. In view of the Applicant's delay in filing the surrender Petition, its prior track record of fee defaults  that necessitated the Suo-motu intervention, the prayer of the Applicant for relaxation under Regulation 23 from the payment of the annual licence fee for the period 1.04.2026 to 31.3.2027 is not allowed.
